School of Chemistry Handsel Scholarship (fee waiver scheme)
6 September 2022
The School of Chemistry can offer a fee waiver through the St Andrews Handsel Scholarship scheme. This scholarship can pay the full international fees for suitably qualified PhD or MSc (Res) students and is competitively awarded. To be eligible for this, you must fulfil the entry requirements for the degree programme, have made a formal application to the School, and have identified a supervisor in the School who has agreed to supervise your research project. For more information, please consult with your proposed supervisor in the first instance or contact chem-pg@st-andrews.ac.uk. Also see the Postgraduate research page.
